timeline.text: In a live interview, every question made the app phone home to Google just to prove you were still you.
That round trip sat on the critical path — one slow check could stall translation mid-sentence.
Worse, the token died after an hour, killing the interview outright.
Now the app checks its own session token, signed locally, no network call needed — Cloudflare Workers does the math.
Sessions now run a full twelve hours without one single round trip.
